excerpt.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
excerpt.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

scope.en: Checked 6095 / 6100 / 6105 and the random_events entry of on_astral_rift_exploration_complete.

texts.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
texts.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

notes.zh: 起点：每次裂隙探索完成时 on_astral_rift_exploration_complete 的 random_events（权重 1 对 49 个空位，即 1/50；00_on_actions.txt:5023-5026）触发隐藏事件 6095。条件：本国物种不是 Blorg 肖像（fun12），没有预设的 Blorg 国家，全局标记 mercedes_spawned 未设。玩家必定得到；AI 只有 1/21 的二次随机。全局只会出现一次。
notes.en: Start: each time a rift exploration completes, the random_events of on_astral_rift_exploration_complete (weight 1 against 49 empty, i.e. 1 in 50; 00_on_actions.txt:5023-5026) fires hidden event 6095. Conditions: the species is not the Blorg portrait (fun12), no prescripted Blorg country exists, and global flag mercedes_spawned is not set. A player always gets it; an AI passes an extra 1-in-21 roll. It can happen only once per game.

label.en: Ignore it, or use it for target practice

note.zh: “这与我们无关”或（仅狂暴灭绝者）“拿来练靶”（凝聚力收入）：逃生舱被放弃，不会再有第二次机会（全局标记 mercedes_spawned 已设置）。
note.en: “This does not concern us” or (homicidal empires only) “Use it as target practice” (a unity income): the pod is abandoned and there is no second chance (global flag mercedes_spawned is already set).

texts.zh:
这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。这只生物突然回过神来，挥动触角自我介绍道:

啊？怎么？这是哪？抱歉。我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，是布洛葛合众国的探险家和外交官。你听说过人类吗？
texts.en:
The repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Abruptly regaining composure, with a flourish of tentacles the creature introduces itself: 

What- Whe- Where am I? I am sorry. My name is Mercedes Romero, explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commmonality. Do you know of the Humans?

texts.zh:
这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。在注意到我们之后，她几乎要猛扑上来，然后又控制住了自己。

你们、你们是人类！？*尖叫*我——我太抱歉了，从我还是一只萌孢的时候就对你们的文化超级感兴趣！

这只外星人伸出了一只触手，令人尴尬地尝试模仿握手动作。

我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，很高兴见到你们。
texts.en:
The repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Upon registering us, it makes a lunging movement before restraining itself.

Y- You- You are Humans!? *Squeee* I- I am sorry, I have been fascinated with your culture ever since I was a little sporeling!

The alien extends a tentacle in an awkward attempt to mimic a handshake.

My name is Mercedes Romero and it is my pleasure to meet you.

responses.zh: 我最后的记忆是在心宿二星系。当时我和一群朋友在一起进行舰队行动，突然看到了一束强光。那之后就什么都不记得了。我是坐着逃生舱来的。孤独且无友。
responses.en: My last memory is of the Antares System. I was engaged in a fleet action with a group of Friends when I saw a bright light. After that there is nothing. I arrived here in my escape pod. Alone and Friendless.

label.zh: 你为什么对人类如此感兴趣？
label.en: Why are you so fascinated with Humans?

responses.zh: 噢，人类，最美妙的生物。我们布洛葛已经关注了他们几个世纪。其实，我们文化的大部分都是基于对人类生活的观察。色彩！戏剧！友谊！他们教会我们生活远不只是生存，甚至还可以交朋友！这个概念真是绝妙，简直可以说是奇迹！
responses.en: Oh Humans are the most wondrous of creatures. We Blorg have been observing them for centuries. In fact, much of our culture is based on what we have observed of Human life. The color! The drama! The Friendship! They have taught us that life is about more than simple survival. You can also make Friends! What a wonderful concept. What a marvel!

label.en: What can you do for us?

responses.zh: 这问题可真不友好，但我有求必应！当然，我有着上百年的驾驶科研船的经验，但我真正醉心的是跨星系关系。把我当成朋友，我可以帮你们交上更多的朋友。拜托了，如果你们感兴趣的话，务必让我代表你们的外交利益！
responses.en: Not a very Friendly question, but if service is required, then I stand ready! Of course, I have centuries of experience captaining research vessels, but my true passion is intergalactic relations. By being your Friend I can help you to make other Friends in the process. Please, if you will have me, let me represent your diplomatic interests!

tooltips.zh: 梅赛德斯·罗梅罗作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Mercedes Romero joins our empire as a Leader.

label.zh: 梅赛德斯·罗梅罗：招募窗口

note.zh: 接上屏幕：Blorg 共同体的探险家兼外交官出现。三次对话（你记得什么 / 为何迷恋人类 / 你能为我们做什么）只是对话，最后可聘用（获得一位不朽、206 岁、杰出级的外交官员，特质为 Blorg 洞察等）或遣散。
note.en: Taking the call: an explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commonality appears. The three questions (what do you remember / why humans / what can you do) are dialogue only; in the end she can be hired (an immortal, 206-year-old renowned official with Blorg Insight and diplomacy traits) or dismissed.

summary.text:
# 最后的逃亡者 / Final Escapee

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`events/astral_planes_events.txt:5208–5393`（6095–6105）；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5023–5026`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（全篇 whole story）

## 如何开始 How it starts

每次裂隙探索完成（`on_astral_rift_exploration_complete`），其 `random_events` 有 1/50 的机会触发隐藏事件 `astral_planes.6095`。条件：本国物种不是 Blorg 肖像（`fun12`），没有预设的 Blorg 国家（`prescripted_blorg`），全局标记 `mercedes_spawned` 未设。玩家必定得到后续事件；AI 要再过 1/21 的随机。全局只会发生一次。

Each completed rift exploration (`on_astral_rift_exploration_complete`) has a 1-in-50 chance in its `random_events` to fire hidden event `astral_planes.6095`. Conditions: the species is not the Blorg portrait (`fun12`), no prescripted Blorg country (`prescripted_blorg`) exists, and global flag `mercedes_spawned` is not set. A player always gets the follow-up; an AI must pass a further 1-in-21 roll. It happens once per game.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 最后的逃亡者（6100）：探球出来时，一个休眠的逃生舱跟在后面，发出简单的求救信号和实时视频。
2. 选择接通屏幕（→ 6105），或“这与我们无关”，或（狂暴灭绝者）拿来练靶。
3. 梅赛德斯·罗梅罗（6105）：Blorg 共同体的探险家与外交官，失去了与“朋友们”在天狼星附近交战之后的记忆；对人类的文化着迷（人类帝国看到另一段文字）。三次提问只是对话；最后可聘用或遣散。

1. Final Escapee (6100): coming out of the rift, a dormant escape pod trails the Sphere, sending a simple distress signal and a live video feed.
2. Take the call (→ 6105), or “This does not concern us”, or (homicidal empires) use it for target practice.
3. Mercedes Romero (6105): an explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commonality who lost her memory after a fleet action near Antares; fascinated by human culture (human empires see another text). The three questions are dialogue only; in the end she can be hired or dismissed.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无视 / 练靶：没有后续（练靶给小额凝聚力收入）。
- 聘用：一位不朽的 206 岁杰出级外交官员（Blorg 洞察、外交委员等特质），可与派系和选举有关（`event_leader = no`）。

- Ignore / target practice: nothing follows (target practice gives a small unity income).
- Hire: an immortal 206-year-old renowned diplomat official (Blorg Insight, diplomacy councillor traits) who may lead factions and win elections (`event_leader = no`).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 6100 的“练靶”仅狂暴灭绝者可见；6105 的正文对人类物种有专属版本。
- 聘用会增加玩家的 `paragon_memory_vault` 变量（若已设置）。

- “Target practice” in 6100 is only shown to homicidal empires; 6105 has a dedicated text for human species.
- Hiring raises the player's `paragon_memory_vault` variable (if set).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：6095 / 6100 / 6105 与 `on_actions` 随机事件项；编译结构正确（图上的 p=0.05 与脚本不符：玩家为 1/50，AI 为 1/50 再乘 1/21）。

- Checked: 6095 / 6100 / 6105 and the `on_actions` random-event entry; the compiled structure is correct (the p=0.05 shown on the graph does not match the script: 1/50 for a player, 1/50 times 1/21 for an AI).
